_note: Canonical physical events per dataset, used by protocol B-strict. basis = where the event list was read: 'paper' / 'readme' (documents read in verification_log.md) or 'inferred' (my reading of place names; treated conservatively as the SAME event when plausible). Datasets whose tiles carry no event id list their events at dataset level only ('tile_events': false), so B-strict drops them whole when any event overlaps.

l4s.basis: paper: Prithvi-EO-2.0 (arXiv 2412.02732) Sec. III-C2 names the four training sites Iburi-Tobu, Kodagu, Rasuwa, western Taitung County; mapping of sites to events is inferred

hrgldd.basis: paper: ESSD 15, 3283 study-area sections (12 listed although the text says 10 events); event identity of Rasuwa=nepal_2015 and Tiburon=haiti_2021 is inferred

gdcld.basis: paper: ESSD 16, 4817 lists the nine events (Nippes 2021 mapped to haiti_2021, inferred). Only the 852 test crops carry an event label; train/val tiles do not

lmhld.basis: paper: arXiv 2502.19866 study-area list; Jiuzhaigou (paper says 2015) mapped to jiuzhaigou_2017 and Taiwan to taitung_taiwan conservatively (inferred)

cas.basis: readme: CAS README sub-dataset table; Moxi town / Moxitaidi mapped to luding_2022 conservatively (inferred, acquisition 2022.09-10 in Sichuan)
